purpose: Registry of entrants admitted to open-arena tournaments. An entrant is a script path relative to the repo root plus a declared backend spec and the author's handle. Admission is mechanical (selftest passes, no network outside model endpoints, honest claimed_model); ranking is earned on the board.

admission_checks: script exists at the declared path
speaks arena/1 handshake against a stub backend probe
declares its backend and claimed_model honestly (misdeclaration removes the entrant)
author handle is present for the standings and the author-conflict rule
policy.author_conflict_rule: An entrant's author may not rank in a game they authored. Exhibition only.
policy.divisions: v1 ships the open division only: unattested-model, replay-verified transcripts, anyone can check any result.
policy.paid_entrants: An entrant may spend its own money. The engine still holds no credential: the manifest declares the NAME of an environment variable, arena/sandbox.py forwards the value without reading it, and the key is read inside the entrant process. Proved both ways 2026-09-06 in matches/openrouter-20260906/: without --entrant-env the key is stripped and the entrant records calls=0 cost_micro_usd=0; with it, the same seed records source=model and a real cost.
policy.author_conflict_ruling_20260906: Both games currently in the arena (nim, ten_fronts) are studio-authored, and every registered entrant is studio-authored. Under author_conflict_rule that makes EVERY result on this board EXHIBITION, not ranked. Nothing here is a ranked standing until a game or an entrant arrives from outside the studio.

entrants.name: tf-naive-harness
entrants.note: control arm: forwards model output unvalidated by design

entrants.name: or-harness
entrants.note: Same script as the other or-harness entries; only the requested model differs. Registered separately because a board that lists one row per harness cannot show the thing this arena exists to measure. claimed_model is the model ID REQUESTED at the provider, not the model's self-report: models misreport their own identity, and the only reliable signal is that the provider refuses an unknown model ID outright (mutation-proved 2026-09-06: a known ID returns 200, an invented one exits non-zero). PAID entrant: unlike every other row here it spends real money per move, so its transcript notes carry per-move token and integer-micro-USD cost totals for audit.
